quote.text: Rationality is the quality of seeing past appearances to discern the true nature of things. We call a person rational who is evenhanded and unprejudiced. Equanimity means the calm acceptance of all that exists and all that happens. Magnanimity means greatness of spirit, unmoved by the lure of pleasure, the lust for fame, and the fear of death.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace rationality by seeking to understand your child's inner world beyond surface actions—this nurtures a supportive environment where genuine character is recognized.
    • Practice equanimity and magnanimity, accepting your child's natural fluctuations with calm and responding with generous love that does not hinge on pride or fear.
  • Leadership
    • Apply rationality to leadership by discerning the true motivations of others, helping you make fair, balanced decisions free from bias or favoritism.
    • Let equanimity guide you in accepting challenges calmly, and allow magnanimity to inspire a spirit of selflessness that prioritizes the well-being of the whole over personal gain.
  • Product Management
    • Harness rationality to see past fleeting trends and opinions, focusing on the genuine needs and potential of your product to steer meaningful innovation.
    • Adopt equanimity in the face of market shifts and magnanimity in decision-making, ensuring that strategic choices are guided by clarity, balance, and a genuine desire to serve your users.
